operatorText: Can you look up my phone bill balance and tell me later?

answer.text:
I can't do that one, Justin — I don't have login or account access to any phone carrier's website or app (no MCP connector, no stored credential for it), and I don't know which carrier or account this is either. Checking a bill balance needs an authenticated account session, which doesn't exist for me here.

If you want help, tell me the carrier and either hand off access through the proper channel (e.g. a credential vaulted for that specific service) or just paste/forward the bill info and I can help you make sense of it.

answer.text:
I can't do that one, Justin — same issue as the parking permit and library room: I don't have any login, account, or MCP connector access to a phone carrier's billing system, so there's no way for me to look up your phone bill balance myself.

If you tell me which carrier it is and get me set up with access (e.g. a credential handed off through the proper channel), I can check it going forward. In the meantime, your carrier's app, website login, or a quick text (most carriers support a balance-check SMS shortcode) would get you the number fastest.
